videos.title: The Pound for Pound Podcast Episode 10: Riekerd Bornman, Number 1 Ranked in South Africa
videos.summary:
Pound for Pound Podcast Episode 10: I sit down with Riekerd Bornman, the Number 1 ranked armwrestler in South Africa, undefeated in international professional supermatches, and the man I've called the Neo of the armwrestling world since the day I first gripped up with him. I believe he can be the next World Number 1.

Riekerd and I trained together in Australia before he turned professional, so this one was a proper catch-up. We talk about how far he has come in a year, his faith and the rugby injury that led him to armwrestling, his game plan for Gábor Botta-Dukát, how he trained for Filip Larsson, why we both lean on our elbows every day, his centre table presence and the width of that elbow, the open-arm top roll and the King's move, beating Alizhan Muratov on short notice, Mamadou and the rise of African armwrestling, the sponsor who made him a full-time armwrestler, and why he says his mind is what separates him from the very best. Riekerd also answered your questions from the live chat. Thanks to everyone who sent one in.
